# Code Browsers

> > A curated collection of code browsers for navigating and exploring popular open-source projects including DuckDB, Flutter, ClickHouse, and more.

Code Browsers provides interactive source code navigation tools for major open-source projects, enabling developers to efficiently browse and understand complex codebases. The site focuses on making large-scale C/C++ libraries, databases, compilers, and frameworks more accessible through specialized browsing interfaces.
